title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: How many subsets of \(\{2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9\}\) contain at least one prime number?

solutions.text:
The set has \(8\) elements, giving \(2^8=256\) subsets. The subsets with no prime use only the four non-primes \(\{4,6,8,9\},\) and there are \(2^4=16\) of these.

So the number containing at least one prime is \(256-16=240.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Count all subsets, then subtract those containing no prime number
The non-primes are \(\{4,6,8,9\},\) so subsets with no prime number are subsets of that set
